text: This code is a correct implementation of the task to calculate a base raised to a non-negative integer exponent using recursion. The function `power` takes two parameters, `base` and `exp`, and returns the result of raising `base` to the power of `exp`. The base case of the recursion is when `exp` is 1, in which case the function returns `base`. For any other value of `exp`, the function calls itself with `exp - 1` and multiplies the result by `base`, effectively calculating the power of `base` to `exp`. This approach is efficient and straightforward, making it a suitable solution for the task.
